from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
C=Path("/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round250-p6-t2-new-run-provenance-correction-20261015")
def pin(p,b=None):
 b=p.read_bytes() if b is None else b
 return dict(path=str(p),bytes=len(b),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
def put(p,b):
 p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 with p.open('xb') as h:assert h.write(b)==len(b)
 assert p.read_bytes()==b
 return pin(p,b)
plan=json.loads((C/'plan.json').read_bytes())
for row in plan['inputs']:
 assert pin(Path(row['path']))=={k:row[k] for k in ['path','bytes','sha256']}
before=C/'before/run-command.py';old=before.read_bytes();target=Path(plan['scope']['only_modified_existing'])
assert target.read_bytes()==old and pin(target)==plan['scope']['before']
a=plan['scope']['exact_old'].encode();b=plan['scope']['exact_new'].encode()
assert old.count(a)==1
new=old.replace(a,b,1)
assert pin(target,new)==plan['scope']['expected_after']
candidate_pin=put(Path(plan['outputs']['candidate']),new)
oldline=next(line for line in old.decode().splitlines() if plan['scope']['exact_old'] in line)
newline=oldline.replace(plan['scope']['exact_old'],plan['scope']['exact_new'],1)
patch=('*** Begin Patch\n*** Update File: '+str(target)+'\n@@\n-'+oldline+'\n+'+newline+'\n*** End Patch')
patch_pin=put(C/'implementation/native-patch.txt',patch.encode())
assert target.read_bytes()==old
print(json.dumps({'candidate':candidate_pin,'patch':patch_pin,'immediate_before_CAS':True,'target_modified':False},ensure_ascii=False))
